intro.@es: La cita directa reproduce palabras atribuidas a una fuente; la paráfrasis resume su sentido sin presentarlo como cita literal.
intro.@en: The direct quotation reproduces words attributed to a source; the paraphrase sums up its meaning without presenting it as a literal quotation.

texto.@es: Comillas, verbos de atribución y referencia deben permitir al lector distinguir la postura de la fuente de la del redactor.
texto.@en: Colours, verbs of attribution and reference should allow the reader to distinguish the position from the source from that of the editor.
